title: Creating Offers in Affiliate Marketing with Sean Chaudhary
description:
This episode with Sean Chaudhary from AlchemyLeads could easily be broken into 2 episodes.
One topic we get into is the idea of how to integrate an offer into your company whether you are a SaaS, agency or an affiliate. It seems offers and guarantees lead to sales. 

The 2nd part talks about plans for 2024 and one theme we touched on is delegating tasks.
